    • CvsSpinner

    Class CvsSpinner

    A control that displays a positive integer where each digit can be changed independently through user-interaction.

    A spinner can have between 1 and 15 reels do can display any integer in the range ≥0 and ≤999,999,999,999,999 depending on the number of reels specified when creating the spinner control.

    Individual digits can be changed by moving the mouse over a reel and

    • dragging the mouse, or
    • scrolling the mouse wheel

    Alternatively the displayed number can be changed with these three methods

    1. setTo(n) immdediately change the displayed value.
    2. rollTo(n, speed) scroll the individual reels to display a new value.
    3. countTo(n, speed) scroll the reels by counting (up / down) to a new value.

    In the last 2 methods the second parameter determines how fast the wheels spin the wheels and the user can set an action wfor when the desired value is reached.

    format

    • format(...cfgs: any[]): CvsSpinner

      This executes multiple formatting functions on this control by passing one of more user defined configuration objects as parameter(s).

      The fields in each configuartion object represent

      • the name of the formating function to be executed, and
      • the actual parameter values to be passed to the function.

      If the formatting function expects multiple parameters they should be in an array. Single parameters can be passed either as-is or as a single element array and pass undefined for any method that requires no parameters.

      This object will change the color scheme, text size and alignment, it will also make sure it is visible.

      { scheme : 'red', textSize : 12, textAlign: ['left', 'top'], show : undefined }

      Attempting to call a non-existent or unsupported function on this control will display a warning in the console window and the program will continue execution.

      No error checking on the parameter types and values, it is up to the user to ensure they are valid for the formatting method.

      Parameters

      • ...cfgs: any[]

        the formatting object

      Returns CvsSpinner

      this control

      Inherited from CvsBufferedControl.format
